user.title: Opus GreenNet Bridge
user.description: Connect to the OPUS gateway in your network. Home Assistant talks to it directly over its REST API; no MQTT broker is needed.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the OPUS gateway in your network.
data_description.port: Port of the gateway's REST API (8080 by default).
data_description.username: API user of the gateway (admin by default).
data_description.password: API password. By default this is the gateway's EURID in capital letters, as printed on the gateway.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect to gateway {eag_id}
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the address and API credentials of gateway {eag_id}. Gateways set up with an earlier version of this integration were connected through MQTT; this version connects to the gateway directly, so it needs the gateway's address once. All devices and entities are kept.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the OPUS gateway in your network.
data_description.port: Port of the gateway's REST API (8080 by default).
data_description.username: API user of the gateway (admin by default).
data_description.password: API password. By default this is the gateway's EURID in capital letters, as printed on the gateway.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection to gateway {eag_id}
reconfigure.description: Update the address or API credentials of gateway {eag_id}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway. Check the host and port.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the username or password.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already configured. Its connection settings were updated.

autolock_read_only.message: AutoLock control is disabled pending manufacturer clarification. Only the reported lock state is available.

gateway_address_required.message: This version connects to the OPUS gateway directly instead of through MQTT. Enter the gateway's address to continue.

gateway_unavailable.message: The OPUS gateway is unavailable. Check its network connection and try again.

invalid_auth.message: The OPUS gateway rejected the configured credentials.

no_loaded_config_entry.message: No Opus GreenNet gateway is loaded.

request_cancelled.message: The request was cancelled because the integration is unloading, the device was removed or the gateway became unavailable.

request_rejected.message: The gateway rejected the request for {device_id}: {reason}

request_timeout.message: The gateway did not acknowledge the request for {device_id}. Its outcome is unknown; check the device before trying again.

wrong_gateway.message: The configured address answers as a different OPUS gateway.
